preconditions.description: The number of steps n must be between 1 and 10^6.
The length of the string s must be equal to the number of steps n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s must be either 'U' or 'D'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers.
Each number in the output must be either a positive integer or -1.
If Olga never goes beyond the stairs, the output must contain at least one -1.
